card.name: Words before potassium and renal terms
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words just before potassium, renal or electrolyte terms, such as 'attenuates' before 'potassium loss' or 'inhibition of' before 'renal prostaglandin'. It appears in drug interaction and diuretic text.

modes.label: Attenuate before potassium loss
modes.description: The verb attenuate/attenuates, said of ACE inhibitors and thiazide-induced potassium loss.
modes.example: Enalaprilat injection attenu<<ates>> potassium loss caused by thiazide-type

modes.label: Linking word before renal terms
modes.description: Small words like 'of', 'on' or 'with' just before renal, hormone or potassium-handling terms.
modes.example: This response has been attributed to inhibition<< of>> renal prostaglandin synthesis.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for renal, electrolyte or hormone terms next, though the promoted tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the word just before kidney or potassium terms in drug interaction text.
